scenes.scene_summary: Ash-Greninja and Alain's Mega Charizard X meet in the decisive battle of the Kalos League final.
scenes.scene_function: Climax of the Ash vs Alain Kalos League final and of the Bond Phenomenon arc.
scenes.why_scene_matters: Culmination of the Ash and Greninja Bond Phenomenon arc and of the Ash and Alain rivalry; one of the defining Kalos League moments; viewers hoped Ash might finally win, and the emotional weight and controversy of the loss are part of its memory; an instantly recognisable visual matchup with strong nostalgia for viewers of the original XY/XYZ run.
scenes.context_requirement: Viewer should know Ash-Greninja's Bond Phenomenon and the Ash and Alain rivalry.
